news.title: ASX slumps despite AI rebound on Wall Street; NAB and BHP decline
news.snippet: The Australian sharemarket was on the backfoot in early trade, with miners and banks leading the losses.

news.title: China’s export boom is becoming its Achilles heel
news.snippet: China is on track for a record trade surplus, but is facing increasing pushback from the countries whose economies are being ravaged by its flood of exports.

news.title: NAB announces it will cut thousands of jobs
news.snippet: The National Australia Bank has announced it will axe up to 2500 jobs over this financial year.

news.title: Aurum hits thick gold ahead of West African resource upgrade
news.snippet: Aurum Resources has extended gold across three targets at its flagship Boundiali project in West Africa, hitting 57m at 2.34g/t ahead of a major resource upgrade.

news.title: Critical Resources triples down on Suriname gold play
news.snippet: Critical Resources has grabbed its third gold play in Suriname, securing exclusivity over the Gadu Manda project, just 4km from Zijin Mining’s 6-million-ounce Rosebel mine.

news.title: Critica tables monster $2.7B valuation for WA rare earths play
news.snippet: Critica Limited’s WA rare earths scoping study has delivered a huge $2.7 billion pre-tax valuation, 56% IRR and $556 million in upfront capital earmarked for a 14-year operation.

news.title: It’s the management stupid; Dollar Bill says back the skipper, not the ship
news.snippet: Boards change, projects change and even company names magically morph, but Dollar Bill asks whether it is real change or just the tired old format re-polished.
